description: This file contains functions and rules for normalizing and migrating legacy Discord channel configurations within the openclaw project, including handling streaming aliases, TTS provider keys, and legacy config rules.

methods.name: asObjectRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if it is an object, otherwise null.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordStreamingAliases
methods.description: Normalizes the streaming alias configuration for Discord channels, updating the entry and recording changes.

methods.name: hasLegacyDiscordStreamingAliases
methods.description: Checks if a value contains legacy Discord streaming alias fields.

methods.name: hasLegacyDiscordAccountStreamingAliases
methods.description: Checks if any account in the provided value has legacy Discord streaming alias fields.

methods.name: hasLegacyTtsProviderKeys
methods.description: Checks if a value contains legacy TTS provider keys (openai, elevenlabs, microsoft, edge).

methods.name: hasLegacyDiscordAccountTtsProviderKeys
methods.description: Checks if any account in the provided value has legacy TTS provider keys.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Recursively merges missing properties from source into target.

methods.name: getOrCreateTtsProviders
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the providers object within TTS configuration.

methods.name: mergeLegacyTtsProviderConfig
methods.description: Merges legacy TTS provider configuration into the new providers structure.

methods.name: migrateLegacyTtsConfig
methods.description: Migrates legacy TTS configuration fields to the new structure, recording changes.

methods.name: normalizeCompatibilityConfig
methods.description: Main function to normalize and migrate legacy Discord channel configurations within the overall config.
